messages:
emily-support: Customer CO-981 opened a support case — structured/json-mode responses are intermittently failing to parse. Their app throws: `ParseError: missing required key 'items'` after a 200 from our API.
emily-support: Customer provided reproducible payload from their logs:
```
POST /v1/generate
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <redacted>
Body: {"mode":"json_schema", "schema": {"type":"object", "properties": {"items": {"type":"array", "items": {"type":"object", "properties": {"id": {"type":"string"}, "value": {"type":"string"}}}}}}, "prompt": "..."}
```
Their app sees a 200 with body `{"results": null}` or sometimes a plain text note, which fails their strict parser.
raj-ml-eng: Any request_id or routing info? Customer pasted: `request_id=01GX3K9B2H`, `routed_variant=redwood-4x-quant-q4v2`, `fallback_reason=hot_pool_full`.
miguel-sre: That matches a pattern we've seen when smart-routing swaps to smaller quantized variants. I recall a change where the quant variant started returning a compact top-level `results` key instead of `items` to save tokens.
jenna-product: If keys were renamed in the variant, that's a contract break. Can we pull the server logs for that request_id?
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1543 - "structured output parse failures from variant routing". Assigned: @raj-ml-eng, @miguel-sre.
raj-ml-eng: Route logs for 01GX3K9B2H:
```
2026-03-04T14:12:10Z INFO routing: preferred_pool=hosted-pool-3
2026-03-04T14:12:10Z WARN routing: pool_full -> attempting fallback redwood-4x-quant-q4v2
2026-03-04T14:12:11Z INFO runtime: model=redwood-4x-quant-q4v2 prompt_len=312 max_tokens=150
2026-03-04T14:12:12Z INFO output: emitted: \"{\"results\": null}\" (len=18)
```
raj-ml-eng: I force-routed to that variant locally and reproduced: curl with `model=redwood-4x-quant-q4v2` + json_schema returns `{"results": null}`. The non-quant variant returns `{"items":[...]}` as expected.
emily-support: Customer rolled back to a pinned model (redwood-4x) as a hotfix. They reported a broken checkout flow and are requesting an ETA.
miguel-sre: Emergency mitigation: I'm applying a short-lived routing guard to prevent smart fallbacks for requests that include `mode=json_schema` and an explicit schema field. Patch: `if request.mode == \"json_schema\" && request.schema != null: disable_smart_fallback = true`. Will deploy to hosted now.
jenna-product: Good short-term move. Long-term: routing should consider per-model output compatibility metadata. Action items:
- raj: audit model metadata for `output_contracts` and ensure we enforce compatibility in routing decisions.
- miguel: add a canary that detects key mismatches at runtime and alerts.
- emily-support: send customer comms + recommended workaround (pin model).

raj-ml-eng: We already capture `output_contracts` in model metadata but routing doesn't consult it. I'll add a check so fallback only allowed if `compatible_with.request_schema == true` in model metadata. Also adding onboarding tests that validate a model against a set of example schemas.

miguel-sre: Suggest adding an explicit model flag `fallback_allowed_for_structured_output` so teams can opt-in for compact responses, rather than silently breaking consumers.

emily-support: I sent initial customer message at 14:42: "We found an automatic fallback to an optimization variant changed the JSON shape. We've blocked that fallback for schema-bearing requests and are working on a permanent fix. ETA 48h." Customer also asked about token/billing — they saw ~+12% tokens from retries; included in the incident notes.

raj-ml-eng: Root cause: an ops/ML tweak for the quant variant switched top-level keys to a compact `results` wrapper to reduce token output. That change was not flagged as a breaking contract in model onboarding.

miguel-sre: Emergency rule pushed to hosted: deploy-2026-03-04-61. Monitoring enabled.

ops-bot: monitor-structured-parse-errors fired 43 times in last 5m. Tracking under INC-2026-1543.

jenna-product: Draft for product comms: "We identified and mitigated an automated routing fallback that changed response keys for structured mode. We're implementing schema-aware routing and onboarding checks. ETA 48 hours." emily-support will send.

emily-support: Customer will keep pinned model for the moment. We'll close once PRs merge and 24h stable window passes.

jenna-product: Adding "Schema-aware routing" to Q2 roadmap.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-1543 status -> mitigation applied, monitoring for 24h stability window.
